source_findings: ByteMixer invokes Lstm::Perceive once per decoded byte.
The donor LSTM training horizon is 128 byte events.
The native update is entered only when epoch_ equals zero after the 128-event horizon.
The proposed midpoint occurs after 32 byte events and therefore cannot invoke an unchanged native full update.
Moving the native update call would leave output updates, recurrent BPTT, Adam moments, history ownership, and state reconstruction undefined.

forbidden_interpretations: No evidence about CMIX midpoint value is recorded.
The v1 contract must not be silently completed after execution evidence exists.
NNCP midpoint evidence does not resolve the CMIX optimizer boundary.
